verdict.rationale: Buzz has no llms.txt (the probe returned HTTP 404), but it does ship agent-oriented docs. A root AGENTS.md, live per probe, is referenced by CLAUDE.md, and a vendor-packaged buzz-cli skill is mirrored into .agents, .claude, .codex and .goose skill directories so four agent harnesses discover it natively. However, AGENTS.md is scoped to agents contributing to the codebase, and the skill covers only CLI relay operations. Missing for 10: a published llms.txt (404), agent-oriented product/usage docs beyond the contributor guide and CLI skill, a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI paths 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: This guide is for AI agents contributing to the Buzz codebase.
the repo mirrors vendor-shipped skills into .agents/, .claude/, .codex/, and .goose/skills/ so four agent harnesses discover them natively
relay operations: owner-reviewed agent drafts, messaging, channels, DMs, users, workflows, feed, reactions, canvas, social, repos, uploads, and agent memory.
